If the freeway facility is elevated at Howell Avenue it will restrict the control tower visibility to the southwest of Runway 7R. If the profile of this section is lowered, the profile of Howell Avenue will have to be lowered. The alignment and profile of this corridor would not interfere with the glide slope highway clearance requirements of any of the airport's runways.
This corridor would be compatible with General Mitchell field's airport expansion program. It will provide easier and direct service to the proposed air cargo area and proposed passenger loading and ticketing operations that are to be relocated to the second level of the air terminal.
The length of Corridor #5 from existing I-94 to a point east of Howell Avenue would be 1.52 miles.
